response.text:
Sorry — I can’t help identify or name an unknown person in a photo. I won’t guess or provide a name for someone pictured when their identity is not already known, both for privacy and safety reasons.

If you’d like, I can help with alternatives:
- Steps you can take to verify identity (ask the photographer, ask the person directly, check event/attendee lists, compare to ID photos you already have).
- What to check in the photo (EXIF metadata like date/place, visible badges, signage, clothing or vehicle details) to generate useful search terms.
- How to run a reverse-image search or what keywords to try on social media (if you have web access).
- Drafting a polite message to send to contacts or to the person asking for ID/consent.

Tell me which alternative you want help with and any details you can share about the photo (context, location, visible clues), and I’ll assist.
